query:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN os.status = 'concluida' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS concluidas,
  SUM(CASE WHEN os.status = 'nao_instalada' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nao_instaladas,
  SUM(CASE WHEN os.status IN ('aberta','em_andamento') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS em_aberto,
  SUM(CASE WHEN os.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sem_os,
  COUNT(e.id) AS total_escolas
FROM escolas e
LEFT JOIN ordens_servico os ON os.escolaId = e.id;
